solutions.title: Word and prefix sets
solutions.strategy: Store every inserted word in one set and every generated prefix in another set.

timeComplexity.explanation: insert creates L prefixes, while search and startsWith do one hash lookup for length L strings.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The sets retain complete words and all distinct prefixes across the inserted text.

solutions.title: Trie nodes with child maps
solutions.strategy: Walk or create one node per character and mark terminal nodes for full-word matches.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every operation scans each character in the queried word or prefix once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The trie stores one node per distinct prefix character path.
